workflow.critical: Execute ALL steps in exact order

step.goal: Resolve suite name from argument or active suite in test-suites.yml

check.if: no suite name argument is provided
file does not exist or active_suite is empty
check.output: ❌ No active suite found. Run /aiqa-analyzestory --suite <name> first, then retry.

step.action: Find the suite entry in TestResult/test-suites.yml where name = {suite_name}

check.if: {current_status} rank is 0 (no valid status — story never analyzed)
check.output: ❌ Suite "{suite_name}" has not been analyzed yet. Run /aiqa-analyzestory --suite {suite_name} first.
❌ Story AST not found at: AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/reports/story-asts/{suite_name}.json Run /aiqa-analyzestory first to generate this file.

step.action: Read the AST file and parse as JSON; if invalid, record as CRITICAL
Count {ac_count} = number of items in acceptance_criteria array

step.goal: Run all quality checks and collect issues
step.action: Read ALL story files listed in {story_files} to verify AC count and text
Count {expected_ac_count} = total unique ACs across all story files
step.check: Story AST JSON file exists and is valid parseable JSON
AST acceptance_criteria array contains exactly {expected_ac_count} items — one entry per unique AC found across ALL story files; no AC may be omitted
Each acceptance criterion text matches the original text from its source story file — no paraphrasing that loses meaning
At least 2 positive test scenarios are defined in the AST
At least 1 negative test scenario is defined per acceptance criterion (count: must be ≥ {expected_ac_count})
Edge cases section is not empty — contains boundary conditions, empty input, max-length, special characters
Security scenarios section covers at minimum: unauthorised access attempt and input injection
Risks and Dependencies section is populated (not empty)
Data Needed section lists concrete test data values — not vague placeholders like "valid email" or "some text"

step.goal: Present validation report and ask how to proceed

check.output:
✅ Validation Passed — /aiqa-analyzestory
All 9 quality checks passed. Story AST is complete and accurate. Suite: {suite_name} | ACs: {ac_count} | Status: {current_status} No issues found — safe to proceed to /aiqa-generatetestcases.

step.output:
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ 🔍 Validation Report — /aiqa-analyzestory ║ ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
Suite : {suite_name} AST : AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/reports/story-asts/{suite_name}.json ACs found in AST : {ac_count} ACs expected (stories): {expected_ac_count}
🔴 Critical ({critical_count}): (for each Critical issue: " • {id} — {description}" + detail) (if none: " None")
🟠 High ({high_count}): (for each High issue: " • {id} — {description}" + detail) (if none: " None")
🟡 Medium ({medium_count}): (for each Medium issue: " • {id} — {description}") (if none: " None")
🔵 Low ({low_count}): (for each Low issue: " • {id} — {description}") (if none: " None")
Total issues: {total_issues}
step.ask: How would you like to proceed? A) Fix ALL {total_issues} issue(s) — resolve every finding B) Fix only Critical + High ({critical_count + high_count} issue(s)) — skip Medium and Low C) Skip — keep the report, apply no fixes

step.goal: Apply fixes to the story AST

check.output: ⏭️ No fixes applied. Issues remain in {suite_name}.json.

step.action: For each issue selected for fixing: SA-1 → re-run /aiqa-analyzestory --suite {suite_name} to regenerate the AST SA-2 → re-read ALL {story_files}; extract every AC precisely; add missing ACs to the acceptance_criteria array; remove duplicates SA-3 → for each AC that was paraphrased: look up the exact original text in the story file; replace the paraphrase with the verbatim text SA-4 → add at least 2 positive scenarios covering the happy-path and an alternate success flow SA-5 → for each AC that has no negative scenario: add a scenario covering invalid input, missing required field, or auth failure SA-6 → add edge cases: empty string input, maximum-length value, special characters (؟!@#), zero / negative numbers SA-7 → add security scenarios: SQL injection attempt (' OR '1'='1), XSS payload (<script>alert(1)</script>), auth bypass SA-8 → populate risks and dependencies based on the story content (e.g. dependencies on third-party APIs, data migrations) SA-9 → replace vague placeholders with concrete values (e.g. "valid email" → "test@example.com", "long text" → 256-character string)
Save the corrected AST back to AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/reports/story-asts/{suite_name}.json

step.goal: Re-verify fixed checks and report final status
step.action: Re-run ONLY the checks that were targeted for fixing
step.output:
📋 Validation Summary — /aiqa-analyzestory
(for each fixed check:) ✅ {id} — resolved: {what was corrected} (for each still failing:) ❌ {id} — still failing: {reason} (for each skipped check:) ⏭️ {id} — skipped (outside selected fix scope)
(if all targeted checks pass:) ✅ All targeted issues resolved. Suite "{suite_name}" — {ac_count} ACs verified. Safe to proceed to /aiqa-generatetestcases.
(if some still fail:) ⚠️ {remaining} issue(s) could not be fixed automatically. Re-run /aiqa-analyzestory --suite {suite_name} or edit the AST manually.
